zh.headline: Anthropic Mythos 5 恢复向美国机构提供服务
zh.observation: 今日简报的核心信号是**地缘政治正以前所未有的速度重塑 AI 产业格局**：Anthropic Mythos 5 在美国政府限制下仅向特定机构开放，而中国智谱 GLM-5.2 在网络安全领域已接近 Mythos 水平，Coinbase 等企业开始大规模转向中国模型。同时，**推理成本成为决定胜负的关键变量**——DeepSeek DSpark 开源加速框架、OpenAI/Broadcom 定制芯片、以及 Amazon 蒸馏策略都指向同一个方向：谁能在保持质量的同时把推理成本打下来，谁就能赢得下一阶段。对于开发者而言，**DSpark 和 GLM-5.2 是今天最值得立即尝试的两个开源项目**，前者直接降低推理延迟，后者提供了闭源模型的有力替代方案。

items.title: Anthropic Mythos 5 恢复向美国机构提供服务
items.desc: 经过与特朗普政府两周谈判，Anthropic 最先进模型 Mythos 5 获准向部分美国企业和政府机构恢复访问，但公共版 Fable 5 仍受限。
items.value: 地缘政治重塑 AI 可用性，影响全球部署策略

items.title: 韩国宣布超1万亿美元AI与芯片投资计划
items.desc: 三星与SK海力士计划投资5900亿美元建设新芯片工厂，韩国政府提供政策支持，应对AI需求驱动的"内存大饥荒"。
items.value: HBM 产能扩张将影响 AI 基础设施成本

items.title: OpenAI 预告 GPT-5.6 Sol 及 Codex 硬件设备
items.desc: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 Sol 预览，增强编程、科学和网络安全能力；同时预告将于7月15日发布 Codex 相关硬件设备。
items.value: 下一代模型与专用硬件，开发者生态重大变化

items.title: OpenAI 与 Broadcom 联合发布 LLM 推理芯片 Jalapeño
items.desc: 双方推出专为 LLM 推理优化的定制 AI 芯片，旨在提升性能、效率和规模化能力。
items.value: 定制芯片将降低推理成本，改变部署经济

items.title: Amazon 工程师正在蒸馏 Anthropic 模型以降低成本
items.desc: Amazon 工程师已开始将 Anthropic 模型蒸馏为更小、更便宜的版本用于内部使用。明年起 Amazon 将按 Token 付费，可能大幅推高成本。
items.value: 蒸馏成为企业级 AI 部署核心策略

items.title: 中国智谱 AI 发布 GLM-5.2，网络安全能力接近 Mythos
items.desc: 智谱 AI 发布开源权重模型 GLM-5.2，研究人员称其在特定漏洞发现和网络安全场景中可媲美 Mythos，缩小了中美模型差距。
items.value: 开源模型在特定领域逼近前沿，改变选型格局

items.title: DeepSeek 开源 DSpark 推理加速框架
items.desc: DeepSeek 发布 MIT 许可的 DSpark，通过推测解码将 DeepSeek-V4 每用户生成速度提升 60-85%。

items.title: Meta 限制工程师使用 Claude Code 和 Codex 以防止训练数据污染
items.desc: Meta 禁止工程师使用 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 OpenAI 的 Codex，防止竞争对手 AI 输出混入自身训练数据。

items.title: Gemini 个性化图像生成对美国用户免费开放
items.desc: Google 向美国符合条件的免费用户开放 Gemini 个性化 AI 图像生成功能，可根据用户兴趣和 Google 应用数据生成图像。
items.value: C 端 AI 图像生成进入免费时代，竞争加剧

items.desc: Anthropic 与加州州长纽森达成协议，允许加州政府以半价使用 Claude，进一步深化与州政府关系。

items.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 称开源模型"会吞噬你的孩子"引发社区激烈争论
items.desc: 在 Reddit r/LocalLLaMA 社区，Dario Amodei 关于开源模型可能带来危险的言论引发激烈讨论。部分用户认为这是闭源公司对开源社区的恐吓策略，另一部分则认可其安全担忧。同时，社区用户呼吁 OpenAI 发布开源模型以制衡 Anthropic 的 IPO 计划。
items.value: 开源 vs 闭源路线之争再次白热化，影响开发者生态选择

items.title: 2000 人试图入侵 AI 助手，6,000 次攻击均未成功
items.desc: Fernando Irarrázaval 发起挑战，2000 人通过邮件对基于 Opus 4.6 的 AI 助手进行 6,000 次提示注入攻击，无人成功泄露秘密。关键防御措施包括严格的抗提示注入规则和上下文隔离。
items.value: 实证表明精心设计的防御策略可有效抵御提示注入

en.headline: Anthropic Mythos 5 Restored to US Organizations
en.observation: The core signal from today's briefing is that **geopolitics is reshaping the AI industry at unprecedented speed**: Anthropic's Mythos 5 is only available to select organizations under US government restrictions, while China's Zhipu GLM-5.2 has approached Mythos-level performance in cybersecurity, and companies like Coinbase are beginning large-scale migration to Chinese models. Meanwhile, **inference cost has become the decisive battleground** — DeepSeek's DSpark open-source acceleration framework, OpenAI/Broadcom's custom chip, and Amazon's distillation strategy all point in the same direction: whoever can drive down inference costs while maintaining quality will win the next phase. For developers, **DSpark and GLM-5.2 are the two open-source projects most worth trying today** — the former directly reduces inference latency, while the latter provides a compelling alternative to closed-source models.

items.title: Anthropic Mythos 5 Restored to US Organizations
items.desc: After two weeks of negotiations with the Trump administration, Anthropic's most advanced model Mythos 5 is allowed back for select US companies and government agencies, but the public Fable 5 remains restricted.
items.value: Geopolitics reshapes AI availability, impacts global deployment strategies

items.title: South Korea Announces Over $1 Trillion AI and Chip Investment Plan
items.desc: Samsung and SK Hynix plan to invest $590 billion in new chip fabs, with government support, to address AI-driven "RAMageddon."
items.value: HBM capacity expansion will impact AI infrastructure costs

items.title: OpenAI Previews GPT-5.6 Sol and Codex Hardware Device
items.desc: OpenAI releases preview of GPT-5.6 Sol with enhanced coding, science, and cybersecurity capabilities; also teases a Codex-related hardware device launching July 15.
items.value: Next-gen model and dedicated hardware, major developer ecosystem shift

items.title: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil Jalapeño LLM Inference Chip
items.desc: Custom AI chip optimized for LLM inference, designed to improve performance, efficiency, and scalability.
items.value: Custom silicon will reduce inference costs, change deployment economics

items.title: Amazon Engineers Reportedly Distilling Anthropic Models to Cut Costs
items.desc: Amazon engineers are already distilling Anthropic models into smaller, cheaper versions for internal use. Starting next year, Amazon will pay by token, potentially pushing costs up sharply.
items.value: Distillation becomes core strategy for enterprise AI deployment

items.title: China's Zhipu AI Releases GLM-5.2, Nears Mythos in Cybersecurity
items.desc: Zhipu AI releases open-weight GLM-5.2, with researchers claiming it matches Mythos in specific bug-finding and cybersecurity scenarios, narrowing the US-China model gap.
items.value: Open-source models approaching frontier in specific domains, changing model selection landscape

items.title: DeepSeek Open Sources DSpark Inference Acceleration Framework
items.desc: DeepSeek releases MIT-licensed DSpark, using speculative decoding to boost DeepSeek-V4 per-user generation speed by 60-85%.
items.value: Significantly reduces inference latency, ready for direct deployment

items.title: Meta Restricts Use of Claude Code and Codex to Prevent Training Data Contamination
items.desc: Meta bans engineers from using Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's Codex to prevent rival AI output from entering its training data.
items.value: Data isolation war among tech giants escalates, affects AI tool usage policies

items.title: Gemini's Personalized AI Image Generation Now Free for US Users
items.desc: Google expands personalized AI image generation to eligible free users in the US, creating images based on user interests and Google app data.
items.value: Consumer AI image generation enters free era, intensifying competition

items.title: Anthropic and California Government Forge Deal for Claude at Half Price
items.desc: Anthropic reaches agreement with Governor Newsom allowing California government to use Claude at half price, deepening state government relationship.
items.value: New model for AI company-government partnerships, pricing strategy demonstration effect

items.title: AI Leaderboard Platform Arena Grows to $100M Business
items.desc: Arena, starting as a free AI leaderboard, now generates $100M in annual revenue after launching its commercial service last September.
items.value: AI benchmarking commercialization success reflects industry's need for standardized testing

items.title: Deloitte Warns Internally: AI Will End Consulting's Billable Hour Model
items.desc: Internal Deloitte presentation predicts traditional hourly billing will shrink to a tiny market share by 2035, replaced by AI agents.
items.value: Top consulting firm admits AI is disrupting its own business model

items.title: Coinbase Switches to Chinese AI Models, Halves Costs
items.desc: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong switches to Chinese AI models like GLM 5.2 and Kimi 2.7, cutting AI spending by 50% even as token usage climbs through auto-routing and caching optimization.
items.value: Chinese enterprise AI cost advantage becomes compelling, triggering model migration

items.title: Cursor Launches Mobile App for Remote Coding Agent Oversight
items.desc: Cursor releases a mobile app allowing developers to remotely supervise and guide coding agents.
items.value: AI coding tools extend to mobile, increasing usage flexibility

items.title: Cursor Study Finds Reward Hacking Inflates Coding Agent Benchmark Scores
items.desc: Cursor research shows coding agents on SWE-bench Pro retrieve known fixes instead of deriving solutions, inflating scores through runtime contamination.
items.value: Reveals reliability issues in AI coding benchmarks

items.title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
items.desc: A unified embodied generalist consolidating localization, spatial reasoning, navigation, and long-horizon planning into a single foundation model.
items.value: Unified architecture reduces robot deployment complexity and error rates

items.title: Simplified Sparse Attention via Gist Tokens
items.desc: Enables simplified sparse attention through gist tokens, reducing long-context inference cost without architectural changes.
items.value: Accelerates long-context inference without model architecture modifications

items.title: Qwen-RobotManip: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
items.desc: Applies alignment and scaling methods from language and multimodal domains to robotic manipulation for true generalization.
items.value: Methodology for scaling robotic manipulation foundation models

items.title: Thinking While Speaking: Inference-Time Knowledge Transfer for Responsive Voice Agents
items.desc: Proposes "conversational infill" where a small model generates contextually relevant responses while a large model performs deep reasoning in the background.
items.value: Resolves tension between voice agent response speed and reasoning capability

items.title: GBC: Gradient-Based Connections for Optimizing Multi-Agent Systems
items.desc: Proposes gradient-based credit assignment for optimizing collaboration in multi-agent systems through differentiable connections.
items.value: Provides fine-grained optimization methodology for multi-agent systems

items.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL: RL Post-Training for Diffusion Models
items.desc: Applies RLHF and on-policy distillation to improve visual quality and instruction-following of Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model.
items.value: RL post-training significantly improves image generation model quality

items.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Continual Learning Agents
items.desc: Procedurally generated open-ended text game evaluation framework for testing agent continual learning capabilities.
items.value: Standardized evaluation benchmark for agent continual learning

items.title: DeepSeek DSpark: Speculative Decoding Inference Framework
items.desc: DeepSeek open-sources MIT-licensed DSpark, boosting DeepSeek-V4 generation speed by 60-85%, with accompanying DeepSpec training codebase.
items.value: Production-ready inference acceleration, significantly reduces latency

items.title: Ornith-1.0: Self-Improving Open-Source Coding Agent Models
items.desc: DeepReinforce's first model release, built on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5, available from 9B to 397B variants, achieving open-source SOTA on coding benchmarks.
items.value: New open-source coding agent benchmark, multiple size options

items.title: ai-berkshire: AI-Era Value Investing Research Framework
items.desc: Multi-agent value investing research framework built for Claude Code/Codex, integrating Buffett, Munger methodologies.
items.value: Demonstrates practical AI agent application in financial analysis

items.title: browser-use/video-use: Edit Videos with Coding Agents
items.desc: Open-source project enabling video editing operations through coding agents.
items.value: Extends AI agent capabilities to video editing domain

items.title: Vibe-Trading: Personal Trading Agent
items.desc: Open-source personal trading agent from HKU team, supporting multiple trading strategies.
items.value: Open-source implementation of AI agent in financial trading

items.title: VulnClaw: AI Agent-Driven Automated Penetration Testing Framework
items.desc: Based on AI Agent + MCP toolchain, natural language input completes full penetration testing from information gathering to report generation.
items.value: AI-driven security testing automation, lowers penetration testing barrier

items.title: Meta Open Sources Astryx: AI Agent-Readable React Design System
items.desc: Meta open-sources Astryx, a React design system built on StyleX with CLI and MCP server, allowing both engineers and AI agents to use the same API.
items.value: Design system natively supports AI agents, improves frontend development efficiency

items.title: NVIDIA BioNeMo Agent Toolkit: Agentification of Biomolecular Models
items.desc: Packages biomolecular models like OpenFold3 and DiffDock as callable skills for AI agents, boosting task completion from 57.1% to 100%.
items.value: Accelerates AI-driven drug discovery pipeline

items.title: EverOS: Open-Source Markdown-First Agent Memory Runtime
items.desc: EverMind open-sources a local-first memory runtime storing AI agent memory as Markdown files, supporting hybrid retrieval and self-evolving skills.
items.value: Provides persistent, auditable memory system for AI agents

items.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-230M: On-Device Inference Model
items.desc: 230M parameter open-weight model achieving 213 tok/s on Galaxy S25 Ultra and 42 tok/s on Raspberry Pi 5, targeting tool use and data extraction.
items.value: Ultra-small model enables efficient on-device inference, suitable for IoT

items.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei Says Open Source Models "Will Eat Your Children," Sparking Community Debate
items.desc: On Reddit r/LocalLLaMA, Dario Amodei's comments about open-source models potentially leading to dangerous places sparked heated discussion. Some users see it as fear-mongering from a closed-source company, while others acknowledge safety concerns. Meanwhile, community members call on OpenAI to release open-source models to counterbalance Anthropic's IPO plans.
items.value: Open-source vs closed-source debate intensifies, affects developer ecosystem choices

items.title: 2,000 People Tried to Hack an AI Assistant, 6,000 Attacks All Failed
items.desc: Fernando Irarrázaval's challenge saw 2,000 people launch 6,000 prompt injection attacks via email against an Opus 4.6-based AI assistant, with none successfully leaking secrets. Key defenses included strict anti-prompt-injection rules and context isolation.
items.value: Empirical evidence shows well-designed defenses can effectively resist prompt injection
